text: I just stumbled onto this place when I was shopping in Castleton and couldn't wait to write a review. I came here at lunchtime on Sunday and did not know anything about it and found by far the best Indian buffet that I've ever had. The quality of the food and the variety was unreal. I typically try to avoid Castleton at all costs on the weekends but I guarantee I'll be back.
Came in for a simple dinner, was shocked by how good it was. Happy hour from 2-7p? Count me in! Got 2 rounds of enchiladas and a half pitcher of beer. Great deals and even better food.

My partner and I stumbled across this by accident. Wanting to try something new, 58hundred popped up as one of the most reviewed local spots. The building is tucked away on a corner and is the epitome of a hidden gem! The inside was cute and quaint, but the patio seating was spacious and open! They had string lights and live music which wasn't so loud that we had to yell across the table as we normally would. The food was fantastic...we had the Brussels sprout tacos (must try!) as well as the salmon and New York strip. There were tons of people with dogs on the patio and they had a cool bar that made lots of specialty drinks with an assortment of bitters. Overall, I think we've found our new weekend dining spot and will definitely bring the dog next time!

Crave has, for 1st time, in my lengthy espresso drinking career, made the smoothest latte, day after day, that I have ever savored!

No sugar necessary. No bitterness, yet full coffee flavor. 

The owner seems to draw upon and really get, the ancient respect and ritual surrounding coffee. 

Comfortable, well spaced tables and clientele that respect Covid protocols make it easy to relax here, in or out. 

One bit of critique though, I am much more satisfied with the owner at the espresso machine: the staff isn't as masterful or consistent when they pull shots. Maybe they could use a bit more mentoring.

I went here for lunch with my brother and sat outside on a brisk fall day. They had heat lamps to keep it temperate and the ambiance was amazing. Perfect balance between casual tone but still upscale in terms of service and cuisine. Our waiter was friendly and attentive and always seemed to be right there when we needed him and not there when we didn't. I appreciated that. In addition to great service we had amazing food. The fresh oyster selection was great and our entrees came perfectly prepared. He got fish and chips which were light and crispy with a fantastic remoulade. I got a vegan zucchini wrapped meatloaf made with beyond meat and covered in an acorn squash cashew gravy. My brother is a "veggie skeptic" and even he agreed this is one of the best meatloafs either of us has ever had. I would eat here again and again.

Yup!
Perfect. 
I don't usually eat anybody else's greens lil baby but Tuh-Dah I got time lol
Yes ghost everywhere it's marie's territory. Bye!

STOP REMOVING MY REVIEW KID ROCK
Seems like they removed my review but as mentioned Kid Rock does not care about the Nashville community in the wake of the Corona virus and decided to keep it open unless told by the governor. Thankfully public shame and outrage work as he is putting the Nashville community at risk . This is not the Nashville way or part of how this community is. 

This place is nothing special other than putting lives at risk due to this virus to get publicity. Nashville 18-50 is the highest age range for the spread of Coronavirus likely due in part to their actSeriously STAY HOME, DO NOT GO TO THIS BAR. There is nothing this bar has that isn't like anything in your hometown other than it is owned by Kid Rock and backers. Kid Rocks actions are despicable, greedy and posts of his venue having crowds of young adults likely exchanging the virus much like a kid rock concert likely goes.

Literally the worst Mexican restaurant I have ever been to. The rice looks like the white microwave rice from Walmart with microwaved vegetables thrown in - the meat was stomach curtailing and the Queso for the chips may be the worst Queso I've ever tried. I'm not usually too picky with food or one to leave a review mostly but this is ACTUALLY the worst place I have ever eaten.
Awesome place for a late night bite. They have several burger options and they all seemed delicious. I had the shroom burger and it slapped.

The last five times I ordered here have been terrible the worst service ever it shouldn't take 2 hours to get an online order that sends an email confirming that it was ready 30 minutes after I placed the order. Good crabs but terrible service I won't be back after 3 years of being loyal and they can check my payment history

The gulf fish (trout) was light, full of flavor, and perfectly crisp. 

The pork was hearty rich, and had delicious beans to go alongside it.

The wagu beef was cooked perfectly wIth the best crispy potatoes and sauce.

The Brussels sprouts blew us all away. 

Our family all shared each dish to see how they tasted and literally all of them blew me away. I'll be sending my friends and family here if they ever  come here to visit. 

This place WILL NOT DISAPPOINT.

I had never had this type of food before and was curious to see what a tamale was all about.  We were greeted by a gal who was not in the least friendly and appeared to act like she was doing us a favor.  We started to look at the menu and she immediately pointed to 3 of the Tamale choices and stated we don't have this, this and that.  Well that eliminated half of the offerings.  When I asked why she said we don't have cheese.  How can you not have cheese??  I then asked which of the Tamales were most popular and she pointed to the 3 remaining on the list??  She then explained these are old menus and we are waiting for the new ones to be made.  The food was bland and unappealing.  The service was just as cold as the food.  Goodness gracious people get your acts together.  I will never visit your place again.  I am surprised you are still in business.
Worth it if you get coupons.  The greek gyro, french dip and cheese sticks are all OK for me!  Somewhat inconsistent but mostly good service at the drive through.  And never huge lines :)

I love Italian food! When I saw a new Italian place in Fountain Square, I was as good as THERE. I made my reservation on Open Table ASAP. 

So let's get right to it. The appetizers. We couldn't choose! So we got three, lol. (Who gets three appetizers unless their job is to review new restaurants?!) Anyway, we got the bread basket, the meatballs, and the ricotta bruschetta. OMG THE RICOTTA BRUSCHETTA. This is what dreams are made of. I could eat this every single day, and I would die happy. It has bread (obviously), fig jam, ricotta cheese, and spicy honey. Omg it's so good. I absolutely LOVED it, and it goes down as one of the best appetizers that I've ever had. 

The meatballs were also very good - loved the sauce. My boyfriend loved the bread basket, but I didn't bother with that. I was busy finishing off the ricotta bruschetta, haha. 

For dinner, I had the Cacio e Pepe with sausage. Ahhh, I loved the sausage - very flavorful. I'm a huge sausage fan, and this place had good sausage. There was a tiiiiiny bit too much oil in it (it kept dripping down my chin, haha), but I really, really enjoyed it. I would definitely order it again. 

My boyfriend had the gnocchi with bolognese. I only had one bite, but it was great. Gnocchi is usually way too heavy for me, but I could definitely eat that, and I would eat it happily. My boyfriend loved and it, and he ate the entire plate, no problem. 

I'm bummed because I really wanted the affogato for dessert! But I ate way too much ricott

Really tasty and fun options for flavored popping boba. I like that you could choose how much ice and how much sugar you want in your drink. 

The staff was very friendly and service was speedy. You can order on little tablets in the shop.

delice has phenomenal cakes, and ive heard even more amazing things about all of their pastry/bread options. i'm not sure if they've changed their workers/practices the last i've been, but the coffee is just not good. their cold brew is insanely weak in flavor, and their espresso always tastes oddly burnt.

Few things are more rewarding than patronizing a business who selflessly gives back to the local community. Each Kyle's visit is a rewarding experience in my eyes. 

This location is fairly new and is flanked by ample parking and a large, sunny patio. The inside decor is fun and urban-inspired which I enjoy. The menu selection is large and they seem to offer a little something for all tastes, particularly those with dietary restrictions. Having such a carefully-tailored menu is rare and I do appreciate that they offer it. I know that I can come here with friends who are vegan, gluten-intolerant or keto and rest assured they'd have a good amount of options to choose from. 

The biggest selling point to me is that a portion of my bill goes to a local charity. They update the source monthly and the featured organization is always a well-deserving recipient. Nice to know that there are still companies who give back to the community. 

The next time you are in the mood to dine on some good fare and help make a positive difference in the SB community, check this spot out.
The dumplings are good, not a big fans of their Chicken Pot Pie Noodle, service was awesome!!

We really enjoyed Firebird this evening.  Our waiter was Jesse.  He was great.  Drinks were great.  Hubby had steak and said it was done perfectly.  We shared the cheesesteak rolls.  Yummy!  I had a salad and coconut shrimp appetizer as my dinner.  Salad was wonderful and slaw was really good too.  I wasn't thrilled with the shrimp but I'm very picky.  We will go back.   The only other thing I was not happy about is a waitress was running a sweeper near us.  That's so darn annoying.

Cheap ingredients, fillings are gummy and artificial flavoring at its best! 

Big time overpriced as well! 

I would suggest the ONLY worthy item in the case are the glazed donuts!

Sorry I couldn't have a more positive review for this Tucson original, you can't have it both ways over pricing and the cheapest quality! 

Have some pride! 

Living on a fading name!

I live close by and have been wanting to try breakfast here for a while.  They did not disappoint.  The breakfast menu is exhaustive, with all the usual suspects you'd expect at a diner.  I had the Baker Burrito and it came with a side of hash browns.  We also tried the avocado toast, which was delicious.  We sat on the patio and they were very accommodating of our dog, even bringing out a water bowl for her.  Service was excellent.  Although I didn't try them, the pancakes looked delicious too.  I'll definitely be back to try more.
Fantastic restaurant with great food! We had a great time. 11 Lemon Drops and loads of food. All of which were awesome.

Had dinner with my husband and another couple, our friends, on Sat. night.  Food was excellent and the service was terrific!  Try the fish tacos if you like fish-  they were delectable.  We will definitely return!
We ordered cream cheese king cake and it was super YUMMY! We loved that it was a simple traditional cake  without a lot of icing. Not overly sweet but great taste

Excellent service and superb Italian cuisine! The high quality pizzas in addition to an amazing selection of wines makes this place a memorable experience. My waiter Evan was knowledgeable, polite and very helpful in helping me and my girlfriend make our selections. Will be visiting again!
Very tasty steak and the brussel sprouts with bacon was great as well. The place had a interesting ambiance I would definitely go again if I am in the area.

Although not like the traditional poke, it's a good rendition and the food is always fresh. They do have a student discount which is really handy if you want to eat healthy. The portions are huge so yay leftovers!

Such a hidden gem. 

Martin's has some of the best wines around town. I attended a tasting with cheese & charcuterie and the best chicken salad around. 


The wines were perfect for pairing. The setup inside is very cozy for dining. I must emphasize that I believe this is some of the best chicken salad.

If you are looking for an authentic curry- COME HERE. This place is absolutely amazing. It will take you to another mindset on a tasteful journey. I think that their curry has warmed my soul inside and out. Absolutely try this. Support small business during COVID. Get carry out. Put in a movie. Instant happiness.

I've been to this location several times over the past year (via the drive thru) and there is always a very long wait. Today I sat in the drive thru for over 20 min, after placing my order. There were only 3 cars ahead of me so I can't understand the wait. The staff never apologize for how long it takes and something is always incorrect with my order. I'm not sure how they stay in business.

This was a excellent dinner from start to finish. It was nice to have a whole foods dinner. Just southern goodness on a plate. The watermelon salad is indescribably delicious. The golden fried chicken & fish is a must try. I dont even care for vegetables but the green beans was seasoned to perfection. My husband & I are definitely hooked on this place. I may bring him back for our Anniversary dinner. Yeah he loved it just that much. The best part of the restaurant is the patio you have to sit on it. And let the romance take over. Five stars to this wonderful place. And the owner is devine as well as his employees. They are kind and wear protective face gear.

Simply amazing, but of course it's a James Beard award winning restaurant. But wow! The land was simply phenomenal, as were the salads and bread. The ambiance is beautiful and they have an extensive wine list. If you are a foodie, you have to absolutely come here.
Was our first time there, but definitely not the last. Oysters on the half shell were great, fish tacos were amazing. Great service, awesome atmosphere.

We've been to other locations and we've been to this location. They are very similar. 

Let me tell you about this last visit. 

We went in at 6:30, not too many people there, it was nice and quiet. 

We sat down, were greeted right away, our drinks came promptly, our order was taken in good time. 

The food was as usual, I ordered the BLT with fries, crispy. The ingredients were super fresh, tomatoes not mushy at all, lettuce was crunchy, and bacon was perfect. 

What made this visit so good was the staff. There was a sign at the register that said they were hiring for all positions which normally means the place is short staffed. And they were! Two employees were doing everything and one of them was new. I mean to the point where the other was telling her where stuff was. 

The one that knew her way around was taking orders, cooking, and serving. She was amazing!

I wish I could remember her name, I would give her kudos. 

This was a really good experience, it wasn't our first time there and certainly won't be our last.

Really nice place to study. I would recommend their fries. Super crunchy and taste just right. The matcha latte could be mixed better, I can taste some leftover matcha powder in the drink. However, the environment is really nice with couches and benches to do work in. I really recommend this place!

Don't let the allure of Instagram fool you. It's pretty to look at but it was not an enjoyable experience. 

If you enjoy screaming a conversation to the person across from you, paying a lot of money for 'meh' portion sizes and dealing with downtown Nashville traffic, then come on by. 

Our first table was very wobbly and the chairs are super narrow. The vibe of the restaurant is not inviting to hang around and order drinks with friends at a table. 

My colleague had to send back his steak 2x. Our hostess was not good, sat us at a terrible spot, only gave us 2 menus for four people. The waitress was very nice, but also forgot to bring stuff all the time. 

The sushi was great, as was the beet salad. 

Other than that, let's just say on the way home we stopped at sonic.

I am Cuban first off and I cook Cuban food everyday and I walk in and first impression is already bad now we ask for cafe con leche which is known for the foam mine had none and coffee was room temp and we order the combo of lechón and shrimp borracho which was room temp and shrimp was just in mojo sauce and it wasn't good and the lechón was salty the white rice was the bottom of the pot so all the hard sticky bottom was what I got and the fried plantains were room temp also shrimp was not fresh it was boxed shrimp for my sons fried shrimp and the only thing that was awesome was the bread and palomilla sorry I will never come back here not good experience if ur used to real Cuban food do not come here!

I love the family feel of this place! The station setup for omelettes being made, the friendly staff who go above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need! The hot pancakes made to order were DELICIOUS as well as the fresh biscuits and all the food in the fix your own plate area. I rarely give 5 stars but whats not to like here!

Will be returning!

I have been here several times and was always pleased with it. Generally get the gyros. Have tried other things also and liked them. Haven't been in awhile cause I moved. Was in the area around lunch time and decided to pick something up to take home. The quantity of the fillings was good but the sauce they put on it was all on one end and had not the flavor it usually did. It just tasted like plain sour cream or yogurt. No fill or cucumber flavor at all. And the paper they wrap it in got wet wit the sauce and I found I was eating paper also. Very sad with my purchase after looking forward to having one again. The staff was great no complaint there.

Have seen this location all around and have always wanted to try it, just have never had the chance. Sunday a friend who works out at the orange theory In the iron works complex suggested we meet here. 
So that was the food gods telling me it was time to go to yolk. Very cool location, I was impressed with the set up and efficiency! You check in with the front and they add you to the waiting list via the yelp app. Which you can live watch  your place move in line. 
It was busy but we  got our table after 20 minutes which was perfectly ok with me..
The menu is awesome, I wanted everything but of course couldn't fit it all so decisions had to be made. I had some fresh beat orange juice, which was earthy and refreshing! A flat white latte for that caffeine perk. For actual food I had the caprese eggs Benedict which was an interesting twist on one of my favorite breakfasts.
The service was quick and punctual, and the bill was cheap. Yolk doesn't serve booze so you walk away with a delicious meal for a minimal cost. I can't wait To go back and have some more!

Stumbled upon this spot after first going to C Factory and an hour wait..walked a few shops down and no wait. I don't know why because everything was delicious! Dumplings were tasty! Inferno ramen and spicy tuna were  on point as well. Thai iced tea was perfect not too sweet.  Sorry only one photo because ate it up so fast because so good

Dim Sum Yummmm....  lol. We have been to the Largo location for pho (FAVORITE!), and wanted to try the dim sum.  We arrived @ 12:15, and waited only about 10 minutes for our table.  The place was packed, lots of dim sum carts being pushed, laughing, and full bellies!  We couldn't wait to be seated and start our Dim Sum feast!! On the menu there are 60 different dim sum items. There are multiple carts full of many types to pick from. But, if you don't see what you want in the cart, they will make it for you, just ask!  We tried so many, and all were flavorful and fresh!  It was hard to go to my favorite pho place, and not order pho....  but worth it!  Only one picture, at the start of our feast, but look how yummy!!  try the pork and ginger dim sum, and the sesame bun!

Great food, celebrated my daughter's birthday night here. Everything was great, Lina the server was excellent and Fluffy the chef was hilarious and put on a great show! Everything was new and the restaurant was so beautiful, we were told they just newly opened. My family and friends had a great experience and we highly recommend it!

I didn't get a chance to get any pictures in. I had my gloves already on when the food came. I ordered the steam bag 1/2 lb of the snow crabs & headless shrimp. It did come with one piece of corn & a few small red potatoes. Also a order of fries. The sauce I got was the butter garlic & lemon pepper mixed (amazing). We arrived around 10:30 on a Saturday night & place was pretty empty. It wasn't any music playing either. The waitress took my order & the food arrived no longer than 10min later. I'm usually a crab leg butter dipper but that sauce the seafood was in taste so amazing I didn't even miss the butter. Food taste fresh as well. I will Definitely return!  

Only downside is it's no liquor yet.

Bar service was great. Table service was great. Quail was delicious.  Fried green tomatoes were good.  Pork tenderloin was good, but salty.  Duck was a complete disappointment.  No flavor.  Not convinced if it was bacon or prosciutto with it, but it was cold!!!!

I had Waitr deliver lunch from here. The grape leaves were cold and not because they got that way in transit but because they were never warmed to begin with. The rice was old and hard. The spinach pie was all bread, hardly any spinach. The hummus had a puddle of water in the middle and is flavorless. The salad wreaked of cinnamon. This is the worst food I have ever had in my life.

Cuba Libre ! 5 Stars  The head bartender as well as our host. the best drinks in town. Those fresh banana plantains hit the spot. Highly recommended. He treated us like family. Came back the next day. Cuba!

This restaurant has been open for about a year. We typically go to M kee or Ting Wong, so we were excited to try a new place. Overall great value for the food.  We ordered several dishes, and overall the food was good.  The chinese style spaghetti (in soup) was probably the best dish. The fried noodle dishes were pretty typical, but I found the rice noodles (ho fun) to be not as smooth as it could be. The wontons in the wonton noodle soup were also not as good as others that we've had. 

Good food, solid delivery. Didn't have the wow factor I would have expected given the other reviews.

I came with a big group for Saturday lunch. Even though there was plenty of open tables, they stuck us in the corner making it difficult for our waitress to pass food and drinks as well as get up to use the restroom. The man who seated was a little rude, telling (instead of asking nicely) us to get out of the way while we waited for our table to be cleaned. 
My mom ordered the nachos and the chips were already soggy when she got her food. Looked like they had been sitting under a heat lamp or something. My quesadilla was good, not great. Most of us were satisfied.  Service was slow in general.

Always a wonderful experience -- even during a pandemic. Excellent breakfast, lunch and dessert all in one spot plus top-notch coffee. Each location is friendly and fast, but Elmwood tends to be my go-to. Easy ordering process/pickup during this whole mess. One of the only places my wife and I venture out to.

First time ordering from this location (pick-up) and all I can say is we have found our new go-to pizza restaurant. We ordered a white sauce pizza with feta and mushroom. It was very well made..the crust was crispy, the ricotta was not wet so it did not make the crust soggy. Mushrooms were fresh. It was great. We will be back.

I don't normally write reviews, but i had to in this case because of the terrible experience my friends and i had.

This past Saturday, 2 friends and i had reservations for 6pm. One of my friends and i got there around 6 and luckily it was relatively empty (maybe 10 people max seated). We weren't acknowledged AT ALL by the one waitress who happened to be out on the "floor". Typically you'd expect a "I'll be with you in a second" or a "please seat yourself" but that was not this case. She finished what she was doing and then went to the back where the kitchen was. After standing there for maybe 10mins, i decided to just seat myself and my friend followed suit. After sitting there for another 5-10mins, a second waitress came out from the back and delivered drinks to one of her tables, still no acknowledgement of new people sitting down before she went back to the back. Then a 3rd waitress pops up and goes to her table to check on them, then goes to the back. My other friend arrives and i tell her what has transpired so far in her absence, so when one of the waitresses pops up again (the 3rd one in this case), my friend grabs her attention and lets her know nobody has come to us yet. She apologized and said she thought one of the other girls had already come to our table but i told her that wasn't the case. She then says she'll go to the back and see who our waitress will be. She goes to the back and i notice her and the other waitresses peaking out at us from the back. She then

So so good! The food is incredibly fresh and it can be made to order to your liking. Friendly staff and hospitable atmosphere. The vodka sauce is out of this world. Just be sure to bring your own wine to enjoy a great meal!

So I've tried this place twice now. The first time wasn't all that great and then almost a year later... it's still not any better. The first time our burger was over cooked, we asked for medium and got  medium well. The second time the BF and I ordered medium-rare and though he received his burger cooked the way he asked, mine was pretty rare. I usually don't mind rare for my steaks, but when it feels and tastes like I'm just raw mushed up meat as my hamburger, it's no good. But, the taste of the burger overall is tasty even when the meat was overcooked. With it being undercooked, it was really hard to get past it for me.

So for me, in my opinion the inconsistency in how the burgers are cooked needs a lot of work, 2-Yelp Stars "could've been better".

Now my bf on the other hand really likes this place and he gives it 4stars because his burgers even though the first time was over cooked, the second time was cooked perfectly he enjoys their flavors.

My roommates and I love to explore different restaurants close to Butler's campus. When we heard about Baby's and looked at its website, we decided to dress up to match the 60s diner theme and visit. 

We were so glad we did. The milkshakes and burgers were phenomenal. They had fun flavors and lots of options for toppings. 

Though we were a little sad that we didn't sit inside to enjoy the fun decor, we were excited to have the outdoors sitting option. There was also easy parking close to the restaurant. 

Baby's provided a safe dining experience. Our temperatures were taken at the door, and there were scannable QR Codes at the table that linked to virtual menus. We had a ton of fun and plan to be back soon.

Stopped by last night to check it out, blown away by the diverse menu.  Got to meet the chef so we came back tonight for dinner. Wow  fantastic.   The ceviche appetizer was enough for two, wonderfully made.  My wife's grilled sea bass was fresh flown in, beautiful presentation.   I had the pistachio crusted rack of lamb. Excellently prepared and presented.   8 lamb chops.  Wonderful service. Lovely evening on the patio
I bought their largest container of vegetable soup.  It was $15.00.  I brought it home and couldn't eat it because it taste like the salty Pacific Ocean!!! Dumped it down my drain!!!!

It's not everyday we go out as a family and for some reason or another we can never seem to decide on where to go, however, earlier this evening we were treated to Taziki's for dinner and I must say, it was a lot better then what I had anticipated. Fresh flavors, clean food with a relaxed, family friendly, casual, and clean atmosphere in the middle of one of the busiest places in the city. 

We started off with some appetizers, the Hummus Trias and the Whipped Feta. The Hummus was delicious with different toppings on each portion. The Whipped feta, however, was the favorite at our table. It was beautifully whipped, with the nice essence of fresh herbs and a dollop of honey. 

Next, for entrees we ordered Grilled Veggie dinner, Grilled Salmon dinner, Grilled Lamb dinner, and a grilled cheese for our littlest one. The sides were pretty much the same roasted potatoes, salad, fruit cup, and chips. Grilled veggies were fantastic and fresh as can be. The Grilled Lamb because of the size, is very easy to overcook and sadly it was but just slightly. It had great flavor and the char marks were on point. The Grilled Salmon came out fully cooked with great flavor and again awesome char marks. 

Overall our dining experience was fantastic with very little wait time or hassle. The staff was awesome and extremely helpful. My only issues and I mean this in the loosest of ways, were the very limited options for sides and the desserts were some what disappointing. 

As a society we need to se

I've ordered almost everything on the French toast menu and I am in love. The owner is very hands-on at his restaurant and takes pride in everything that is happening in back of the house. He most of the time, greets the Visitors himself :-) if you are in the area this is a must try diner :-)

We stopped into the Union Station Hotel for a bite to eat at Carter's restaurant. The hotel was a train station in the 19th-century! The lobby is gorgeous and has a vaulted ceiling with stained glass. We sat in the lobby and ordered drinks to start. Our waitress, Amanda, was very knowledgeable. Some of the recommended liquors were High West Double Rye, Belle Meade Bourbon, Botanist Gin and Angels Envy Rye Whiskey.  My favorite was definitely the Angels Envy! 

We tasted a little bit of everything! 
-Watermelon salad 
-Heirloom Tomato salad
-Seared Pork Belly on Bao buns
-Lobster tacos in wonton shells
-Truffle fries
-Seasonal flatbread 
-Milk & Honey 

Everything we tasted was delicious but here are some of the things we loved:
-The watermelon salad had both red and yellow watermelon. I had never tried or heard of yellow watermelon- was very sweet!
-Heirloom tomato salad was amazing  and all the flavors mixed beautifully! Burrato cheese is a new favorite!! 
-The pork belly melted in your mouth! 

This restaurant is a must stop! If your not staying at the hotel make sure you stop here for a drink and a bite to eat. 
Compliments to Chef Jim and the entire staff on a mouthwatering lunch!

After you finish your meal, walk around and look at the history in the hotel. The front desk will give you a paper explaining the history of the hotel for a self guided tour!

Chevys just turned me away from their patio seating. I brought two little kids in and they told me that it was a 30min wait. More than half of their tables on the patio were open. They stated that they were short staffed yet I saw approximately 7 employees from the hostess stand. Really confused why they wouldn't seat people. It seems employees don't even want to go there lol. I get being understaffed and I wonder if there is a way to make people who come to their door feel more valued. Maybe simply asking for a bit more patience if we were to be seated. Or using some of the hosts to fill drinks or something. This is not what I do but this was disappointing.

Solid brunch spot that has great options for meat eaters and vegetarians/vegans. I got the multigrain porridge bowl which was outstanding! It costs $9 and is technically considered a side. It's pretty hefty for a side, but not enough to be its own dish. I sort of wish they'd throw some fresh fruit on top, make the portion of porridge a little larger, and promote it to entree status. To round out my meal, I also got a side of cheese grits that were slightly too salty, but still good. The only thing I'd really change about this place is the cash only situation.

Kazoku ramen does one thing very well, and that's their tonkatsu ramen. The broth has depth to its flavors, unlike many other ramen joints around the city, where behind the veil of salt lies not much else. 

Hidden in an old building where a strip of restaurants call home, the atmosphere is relaxed when you enter. Service is adequate and of average speed. 

We have tried the kazoku ramen (a lighter version of the tonkatsu), tonkatsu ramen, and some side appetizers and found that the tonkatsu (pork bone) based broths are definitely their strong suite. Appetizers were lacking in flavor or overly fried and therefore would recommend only the pork broths when a craving hits. Portion sizes were generous and you definitely leave full. 

Note: they are closed all of Sept 2019 and reopen sometime in October. Also, they are cash or debit only, which is a minor inconvenience.

Outstanding food!  Outstanding service!  Love the atmosphere and the beer was fantastic!  Will be back to sit outside and finish the night with ice cream and coffee!  Next to beer, two more of my faves!

Some really good NY style pizza.  Great crust, good amount of toppings.  Right amount of cheese and sauce.  Also had the right amount of grease on top.  Fold ability was also great.  Would recommend to anyone.

I gotta be honest, I wasn't sure what to expect because of all the hype I heard about Big Poppa burgers but those were the best burgers I've ever tasted.. ever!!! The salmon burger was amazing and I don't know if it was their special sauce or the way they grilled it but the burger was absolutely delicious. I'm coming back for sure!!!

Did a take-out order... coconut soup as part of combo was good, just wish it were larger Pad Thai was decent, a tad dry, but level 2 spice was spot on and flavors were good. Pumpkin curry was excellent. Mango sticky rice for desert was on-point. Solid Thai overall, not the best I've ever had, but not bad.

Oh, do I ever want to give this place more than 5 stars! The food at this unassuming place is ah-may-zing! All the meats are smoked & are worthy of special mention, but the real superstar is the smoked brisket! Never have I had brisket that literally melted in my mouth. Chewing is almost optional. I ordered the brisket sandwich with a side of pickles. I received a large sandwich on a soft, buttered & toasted bun. The bun was bursting with brisket...no skimping here! My husband ordered a two meat plate with 2 sides. His smoked sausage, pulled pork, Mac & cheese, & baked beans were all yummy, too. Beware, they open at 11 & often close by 6 because they are sold out of meats for the day. If you want to go to brisket Nirvana, do yourself a favor & get to Holy Smokin Butts BBQ!

Monday nights. Filet and lobster.  Salad and dessert.  $50.  Hot bread and flavored butter. The Caesar Salad was cold and crisp. My steak was perfect, the lobster was tender.  I love their creamed spinach, Fleming's potatoes and sautéed mushrooms (a la cart).  And desserts to die for.
Our order got messed up but the food we received was great. The lunch specials are an awesome deal!
This is how you do a Mexican restaurant. The food is amazing and I have never been disappointed with the service.

While i couldn't eat anything due to no gluten free options which I really hope will be changing my friend liked the bagels and the ice coffee was good mixed the Capp and cold brew with the coffee cubes. Will def be returning if gluten free options arise

Date night with the wifey. We wanted to try somewhere different. Checked yelp and...bam... Cena showed up. Ok. Let's keep this short and sweet. The service was amazing. Our waitress walked us through all the courses and helped make recommendations when needed. 5 star service. The food. Outstanding. From the cheese platter that was on special to the risotto and egg plant. Then... then the special of the night. Tomahawk!!   

The atmosphere is trendy yet romantic. The wine and drink selection is good. 

As other has said, the menu is always changing and evolving so make sure to check it out!!!

Highly recommend Cena!!!!!!

I came with a party of four around 9pm on a Wednesday. They were pretty busy considering the time. There was a 10 minute wait. They took my number and text me when our table was ready. The table was ready within the 10 minutes at a hibachi table. Our chef's name was Vedo. He was funny and put on a good show. 

I had the filet minion. The steak was cooked perfectly and seasoned just right. It came with fried rice, noodles veggies and soup and salad to start. They provided a side of yum yum sauce and filled it up again before they left the table but did not give any of the brown ginger sauce. 

My friend ordered the steak and chicken combo but got steak and shrimp. Everyone loved their food and had plenty of leftovers. Our server boxed up our food and gave us a soufflé cup of yum yum sauce to go. 

We ordered 3 scorpion bowls. They came out on fire! The drinks were yummy but the last one we ordered had more ice than beverage in it.

Pizza Pie
My husband and I were in the mood for ordering pizza, and since we had never tried Pizza World, thought we would give it a shot. 
The guy who answered the phone and took our order was polite, and willing to accommodate.
Delivery guy also was easy to deal with and again, polite.
Now as for the pizza - it was rather dry. Could have used more sauce, more cheese ,pepperoni and black olives.
Also ordered 12 ravs which seem to sit in the fryer a bit too long. They were dry with overly crisp edges. The sauce that came with the ravs was cold.
Thought they were pricy for what was given. Don't mind paying a bit more, if we feel as though the food is good but this was nothing great. There are other places to order from. Won't order from here again.

Absolutely delicious.

I stayed in the hotel this restaurant is in, and this restaurant was definitely the best part of the hotel.  The food and drinks here are just really damn good - everything tastes fresh, flavorful, and simply well-prepared.  I especially enjoyed having brunch here - the biscuits and gravy were a huge stand-out, weirdly enough.
Excellent food and management. They're constantly improving their menu with out of the box options.
They have the best sangria! Their food is fantastic I recommend you definitely get the shrimp fundido and the black bean soup! It has more beans than broth!

Eat out all the time. Given this place 2 tries to get it right. Cmon guys, it's Italian, not to hard to give it flavor. To sum up in a word: Tasteless. Guys, your spaghetti and meatballs are STILL VERY VERY bland. Benzino Sea Bass was rubbery and under seasoned. Give it some flavor. The short rib bolagnese was recommended but was just tasteless noodles with under seasoned  shredded pork on it. Beet salad was meh, Ceaser Salad was "you tried too hard" on the flavor,  so it was strong but no depth. The Caci pizza was good, but again, tasteless shredded meat thrown on top just doesn't work. Crust was very good and crunchy with flavor. Server and host were nice and welcoming. Place was clean, ambiance was warm and cozy. YOUR FOOD FLAVOR IS YOUR NEGATIVE. I go out to eat for the experience of community, flavor, service and atmosphere, . Your  Service and Atmosphere were great, your food is not. Invest in some better recipes with depth and flavor and you will have a winner. Last time we went was 6 months ago and there has been no improvement(or decline). Will try again in another 6month to a year. Also (There was a hair in my Short Rib dish), certainly didn't help the overall experience!!

What a great place for food and drink.  The host seated us right away on a Saturday night at 630. We thought we would have to wait but to our surprise a table was ready for us. 
The drinks were great and the apps delicious. We had the hummus and another the SOMO disco fries.  You have to try these. It has bacon short ribs cheddar and gravy and yummy.  Dinners were beet salad shared with one of the burgers.  I had the fried chicken sandwich and boy you have to try this. It was delicious. 
We had one hiccup, we ordered drinks during our meal and they took awhile. We asked and they worked on it and finally they arrived.  The waitress was very gracious and apologetic and gave us the round on the house. I did say something about it again and to our surprise the hostess came over and again apologized. They have a wonderful staff and we will definitely return.

Was very satisfied by this restaurant.  The sushi here was very good and there were SEVERAL types to choose from as well.  Noticed that the entire time I was at this buffet there was someone constantly rotating food and replacing with fresh food.  The service was also very good as well.  As far as Asian buffets go this would have to be one of the cleanest most well maintained that I've been to in a long time.  I'm certain the next time I'm in the area I'll be eating here again.

Saw the reviews and I was excited about coming here with my boyfriend! Unfortunately the service was bad. We had to continuously approach them and they were on their phones FaceTiming/playing videos games the whole time we were there. Also- we were given these awkward "happy birthday" plates for our appetizer. The whole vibe  was just off, and not to mention the food was okay. Our meals were very bland even though we asked for extra spicy. We ordered tofu and it was over-fried and bland. Hands down the worst tofu I've ever had, and it's really hard to mess up tofu lol. Would not recommend. I hope they read these comments and change their approach.

Wow, we came here to determine with us fattys which place has the best muffuletta . 

We walked into a small but classy butcher shop. We didn't know what to expect. The decorations of the restaurant were cute and funny. 

We said out loud we're only here for a muffuletta . No games no thrills just bring it ! I asked the girl at the front who has the better muffuletta, them or central. She said ours will be better as we make our own meat. I said ok bold statement. 

We ordered and sat down. They brought the stuff and we took the pics. We then bit into it. Wow!!!! That was amazing. It was warm but damn it was tasty. It had crisp meat and the olives were not over powering. 

I gave them a standing ovation. 

We are now walking to central to determine who really is the best.
Perfect place to enjoy a cup of delicious coffee with friends. Outside patio seating is a plus, especially when the gorgeous magnolia tree is in bloom. It is spectacular!

I love shopping at this outlet mall. It's not the biggest around (I grew up near Woodbury Commons in New York and used to shop there) but it features a number of my favorite brands so it's where I always go first when I need something. DKNY, Calvin Klein, Nike, and the Cosmetic Company Store are my main stops. You won't find some of the more high end brands like Gucci or Ferragamo, but you also won't find the massive crowds of tourists being bused in, like at Woodbury Commons. So it's generally a calm and pleasant place to take your time shopping.

I do wish there was a better dining option on site, at least a higher end chain that was better than the Friendly's that's there right now. And the food court is kind of limited. But otherwise, I'd still rather shop here than at the nearby Deptford Mall any day of the week.
Food was good and it was very well priced compared to the chain restaurants.
This is a cool spot to go to but everytime I go there the security at the front door is always rude!! They should really fix that issue being that security is the first impression of the lounge! Ok

Really excellent English/Aussie food! The bangers and mash was terrific and the pub burger was so satisfying. They advertise themselves as a bakery as well as an eatery, but not many baked goods were available and they weren't prominently displayed. When we tried some for dessert, though, the pavlova was great. The lambington, on the other hand, is kind of dense and bland--the only thing we ordered I wouldn't be happy to eat again.

UPDATE: I took the lambington cake home and warmed it up to eat after dinner. It was GREAT! Completely changed my mind about it. I recommend Walkabout serve these warm, not cold from the fridge case.

I've only gotten take out from here a few times before and my experiences were always spotty. I'm writing today because it might be my last time ordering from here. I ordered the farmhouse hash. Looks good but doesnt taste as good. Super super salty I couldn't even finish half of it. I ordered my eggs over medium but were so dippy that that the yolk was runny over my entire meal before I could take my first bite. Gross! Also, the avocados in my order were old and brown. I wanted to call in to let them how I felt but the last time I did that when I wasn't satisfied, they only apologized and didn't offer to fix my order. Most likely never ordering from here again.
Best donuts around and the staff is always very friendly! Their pepperoni bread (I think it's only a holiday item) is great too. Definitely recommend!

We took the morning excursion.  The tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable but was not very charismatic.  The battleground stop was interesting.  The food was surprisingly good!  Excellent jambalaya! The endless drink option includes either mimosas or bloody Mary's.  Mimosas were not great but the bloody Mary's were good.  You need to keep your cup in order to get another drink so that was weird when we had to get off the boat for the battleground tour.  The boat was really nice and we had a lot of freedom to either stand or sit down inside or outside.  We learned a lot about the history of New Orleans and the culture.
Excellent please for coffee enthusiast. Great service and fantastic food. Feels like Paris or İstanbul coffee shops.

Very cool / unique place. Great date night or spot for a guys night out. Strict dress which I appreciated. Menu was pricey but the food was good and it's all part of the experience. Table side magic show was cool and broke up the experience from 'just eating and chatting with my date'. Wide selection of custom cocktails. Ended the night with a magic show in another room. 

Pricey but worth it. I think it's a one time experience that is a must for Nashville, but I won't be back as I feel I experienced it.

This location is your typical pizza shop you would expect. Upon arrival you may notice the parking lot can be a little crowded at times due to other businesses, and parking during peak hours can be difficult. It is not a consistent issue though. The interior is a bit dated in my opinion. Just a bring your kids or team type of pizza place. I have had the pizza several times and find it good. Everyone has their own opinion on what a good pizza is so I won't try to convince anyone here, but if I am craving the large slice pizza of old, this is it. I have tried other menu items and find them average fair. The Stromboli,like the pizza is also decent, but I feel other items miss the mark. The chicken parm for instance taste like frozen microwaved chicken. The spaghetti seems never to be drained enough thus leaving your noodles resting in watered down marinara. I personally prefer spaghetti sauce, so I find the marinara thin in consistency as well and there is never enough on their food. The salad provided is hit and miss. Sometimes you seem to get a large chunk of the lettuce stem but other times it seems fresh chopped. They do provide garlic knots (bread) with the meal which are ok. All in all I would say if you are looking for a quick sit down pizza joint you can bring your kids to, and you are not expecting too much, it is n ok local place to go, but I wouldn't recommend a special trip here to try it. Like some restaurants, this one survives by location, convenience and pizza de

Recently went for restaurant week and chose outdoor seating. They put us basically at the furthest table in back even though we were offered a table on the street but then the hostess said "nope, never mind you cannot have that one." The chairs were hard as rock, table was on a slant, tiny, hardly any room to eat. Food was gross overall, bread was cold, oil was plain, no salt or pepper or cheese, main courses were a bore, tiramisu was not layered, spongy and disgusting. I had the worst stomach ache afterwards. I got the gnocci and the waitress didn't come back to our table until 15 minutes after we got our food. There was no parm cheese offered. My food got cold by the time I could get any. My friend got the chicken, which was absolutely nothing special. She didn't even finish it because it was so blah. I cannot imagine paying full price for this horrid experience. Highly do not recommend. One good thing i will mention is the Caesar salad was tasty but literally nothing else was.

i am very displeased with my visit. i ordered a bogo free. the waitress put in a double order. me and my brother was sharing... i called the waitress back to the table and told her she gave me too many.. she said she apologize and got the manager... the manager to told me, you ordered them , you pay for them. i told them i'm not payin gfor something i didn't order or eat...my brother paid the bill without my knowledge...they have lost my buisness forever at that location..that was totally unprofessional..THE WAITRESS NAME WAS KIKI, SHE AVOIDED THE TABLE AND THE MANAGER NAME WAS ADAM

It was ok. It wasn't great, wasn't terrible. Found it odd that on a Friday night only 1 server was working and the greeting began with "I am busy with other tables but I will get to you shortly." Was not a great first impression. Overall the server was actually pretty decent, other than charging us for dipping sauces (ranch) and not informing us there was a charge. Temperature in the restaurant was also way too warm, we were sweating our entire meal because of the 1000 degree oven and it seems their A.C. can't keep up to regulate the temp. Pizza was overpriced for something that was honestly just OK. If you're looking for fantastic pizza, don't come here. If you're looking for a local spot to grab some quick mediocre food, it will do.

Not a great showing tonight at Grimaldi's . The Bartender doesn't know how to make a proper Margarita. Sloppy mix - no finesse whatsoever. Unprofessional bar operation. Moving on......

The Lady Greeter at the entrance podium was indifferent and lacked poise! Perhaps the Greeter and the Bartender could look for employment elsewhere.

The Pizza was......Grrrrreat! Our server Crystal was cordial, polite and attentive. Excellent service.

Perhaps the Manager was off duty tonight. No idea . The place wasn't its normal self. We have had so many good meals here and for this reason I am going to give Grimaldi's a pass. We will be back. Hopefully the Greeter and the Bartender will have moved on by then.

Okay last night I saw a picture of the spicy beef sandwich and had to return here for lunch today.

Absolutely phenomenal tasting!

We had the meatball and spicy beef with cheddar.  I'm perfectly satisfied now! Yum!

Very good place for a tasty sandwich in an eclectic setting.

As McArthur said ..."I will return!"
Thanks for the great Christmas dinner and conversation ladies. The spaghetti and hot sausage were great !!!

This Taco Bell suckssssss. I literally had to go through there drive-through 3 times. The third time I went through I had to go to the window and wave at them. They told me they didn't have their headsets on and keep in mind it's 9:45am; breakfast starts at 6am. Next I asked if I could just order at the window then and she said "no, you have to go back around".  Now that doesn't make any sense to me at all. So I ordered and I could barely hear them. I literally had to turn my car off to hear them. FINALLY! once I got my breakfast crunch wrap; it didn't have any jalapeño sauce like It usually does and no regular cheese. Yeah it had cheese but it was nacho cheese. Like it was melted cheese.It just tasted so odd.  So yeah obviously this Taco Bell sucks and I won't go back again. Please get a new manager or whatever it takes to get a better business.

Had the brunch here while staying for Mother's Day weekend.

Eric was in training but did a wonderful job. Probably the best server I've experienced in a while. Wasn't pushy but was always there if we needed something. Especially a good refill on a bottomless mimosa.

Ramen is good, but the takoyaki and curry tonkatsu rice bowls are something else. 

The takoyaki is the best in philly by far - there are generally 3 large chunks of octopus per piece, which is the way it is supposed to be, but other restraints are too cheap to make

Great place. Eat there at least once a month.
This is the best Thai food in Brandon, riverview area. Ate here many times always met expectations. !

the service sucked!! i swear these people are racist. the guy said the card machine didnt work so i needed to go to the fucking atm and got charged $4 for it and then i wasnt gonna tip i tried walking out and the guy was like "excuse me we include the tip" and i was like fine i'll give you $5 to shut up" and i walked out. HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE!!!! I HOPE THIS BUSINESS SHUTS DOWN!!!! BUSINESSES LIKE THESE DONT DESERVE TO STAY OPEN! food was nasty too. they probably spit in it to be honest

I've been to Noshville many of times. There is something to be said for consistency. It's the exact same each and every time. I typically switch between their lox bagel and corn beef hash omelette each time and it's always good. The silver dollar potatoes is also a must add. Friendly staff, easy in and out. They also serve alcohol if you're wanting to brunch it out but not get into the trendier areas in downtown Nash. Highly recommend.

The food is good but the delivery service is terrible.  The first time we ordered delivery they took it to the wrong address and never bothered to call us to try to remedy the situation.  They just didn't deliver the food.  When we called, the remade the order and brought it to us. The second time, they brought us the wrong food, told us we would get our correct order right away.  After an hour of waiting (we live 7 minutes away), we called and they told us the delivery person was out and it would be here soon.  After an additional 45 minutes of waiting we called again and they told us that the delivery person would be there in 7 minutes.  Three minutes after that call they called us back and told us that the pizza was leaving the kitchen now. So they sent us the wrong food, told us they would fix it, then didn't do it until we called again to find out where the food was.  Never ever again for delivery!

Update: tried this place again for take out to avoid the terrible delivery service.  Pizza was great.  Antipasto was pathetic.  One single piece of prosciutto, some cheese and fruit on lettuce? This would hardly constitute an antipasto platter at any other Italian restaurant I've ever been to.  Veal saltimbocca was not served with pasta-instead came with a salad and a very small amount of sautéed spinach. The portions we had were quite small compared to other Italian places in the area with no better quality here.  This is definitely more of a pizza/sandwich place.  Avoid sal

I've been to this place quite a few times and it is one of my absolute favorite local restaurants on the Illinois side of the river. We loved dining in before the pandemic, but I'm almost even more impressed with how flawless their online delivery / pickup has been! They even distill their own hand sanitizer, which they include a small bottle of in your order. Everything we have had has been delicious. My personal favorites are their wings and beers. My friend got their Cuban sandwich and developing story drink kit, and she cannot stop raving about it! My only complaint is that their online order menu is more limited, but completely understandable given the circumstances! If you haven't eaten here yet, you absolutely must!

Where to start. Ordered go to and they said they will bring it out curb side. Waited 15 minutes once I got here and passed the time they said it would be ready. I went into the restaurant and 5 employees are standing around and just looked at me. Then after telling them what I was here for i waited another 10 minutes for my food. After I got it and glad I looked before I left it was cold and my wrap had a few small pieces of chicken in it. They seam to not care about customers and their food they serve. I will never be coming back here. Make people want to come back not as they are a Burden to you and the staff.

Being new to the neighborhood we stopped in to try the wings! We were so unsettled because there were no people of color in there we've been afraid to try new small local bar & grills. This restaurant is all about making people feel good and feeling welcome,  that's especially important this day in age! Wings and service were absolutely amazing! We will definitely be back
Great shrimp wet burrito and house Margarita.  A very small restaurant and if the weather is awful it is a challenge to get seated.

First time here and loved it! 2 amazing knowledgeable bartenders who know their stuff. Nice wine last and very pretty atmosphere. Sat at the bar for dinner and started with chopped salad which was delicious. My hubby had really good meatloaf wrapped in bacon. I had seafood with angel hair pasta. We will be back!! Great place and even better service:)

I love it here! The food is always amazing and there are many menu options to choose from. The only reason I am giving 4 stars as opposed to 5 is because the service is very, very slow. I've dined here for lunch a few times and I have never gotten in and out in less than two hours. A little over the top for lunch... but if you have the time, then it is worth it!

While visiting family up north we decided to order delivery as we were craving some Thai! Thank you Thai Sushi House! It wasn't overly spiced, great portion sizes, excellent flavors. Our little ones kids meal was over cooked, which I understand chicken nuggets and fries aren't exactly Thai but it was on the menu

Good pizza, especially if you're from the Chicagoland area and just can't adjust or accept that terrible STL provel cheese. Sauce does have a bite, so if you don't like heat or have a sensitive tummy, this isn't for you. This is my go to place for deep dish in the neighborhood.
Great food! This place has great service and a nice menu. Lots of seating so you don't wait long. The tuna melt is awesome
The best ice cream I've ever had. It's homemade and so much better than anywhere else I've been. The milkshakes are amazing, if I could have one every day, I would.

I recently dined at Gabi with my friend Chris W after much fanfare from the people in my inner circle. We ordered the Steak Tartare as an appetizer and were immediately impressed with the presentation, taste, and portion size. The tartare was presented mixed with brined capers, freshly chopped onions, finely chopped parsley leaves, and a raw egg on top. Cornichon's, mustard, and lightly toasted baguette wafers accompanied the tartare. It was a really great tartare, one of the best in the city! Unfortunately, the entrées left a lot to be desired. My friend's Beef Bourguignon (burgundy-style beef stew, bacon, pearl onions, mushrooms) was a bit overcooked. The bacon and beef were tough chews. My Duck Confit (duck leg cooked in its own fat, orange sauce) was just okay and cooked a bit too long, too. I've had a better duck confit at Parc and Bistrot La Minette. The side vegetables of puréed potatoes and French green beans (haricot verts) were exceptionally done, however. Oftentimes, chefs cook them a little less than I'd like, making them more raw than cooked. These vegetables were prepared and spiced perfectly. I'm not fond of the Mercer-style bistro plates. I get why they chose them, but it leaves a lot of empty space on my dish. My drink, La Minette (blood orange, vodka, Lillet, soda water), lacked the usually tang of blood orange. It tasted more like regular orange. I typically order dessert from a place I really like, so perhaps I'll try this place again at some point and ord
Sorry no pictures but the food was awesome. Nothing was bad. $3:00 margaritas ( very good) very large draft beers. Food portions were huge. We will definitely be back

Was pleasantly surprised by this place on carrolton. My friend who is a regular here always gets the poke bowls and swears by them. They definitely look super appetizing! I tired the pork rice plate dish and was impressed by the portion size and the meat quality, although the meat was a bit over salted. Reasonably priced, and offers lots of options! The ambiance inside was comfortable and casual. Will probably come back and try one of those poke bowls.
My husband and I love to come to this restaurant when we  travel into Tucson. We fly down every year from Alaska and this is the first place we go for comfort food highly recommend it.
Great friendly service considering the Covid19 issues! Rice and peas were great, roast pork shoulder was amazing, and so was the jerk chicken!

I have been to several Nico's around Tucson and this one is not there best representation of what they can do. The guy who works the counter in the evenings is gruff/unfriendly, which I find ironic when you have to have public interactions. One would think you would want to put your best foot forward in that area. Food is just ok at best. Been to this place more than once and I am likely not going to repeat it. Yelp on!

I'm glad I went before reading all the negative Yelp Reviews.  We went at a friends suggestion and it's just good, old fashioned burger joint food.  Perhaps it's because of all the new equipment and reopening, but everything we ate was fresh (including the great fried Zucchini), a basic (but really good) grilled cheese, and my husband loved his BBQ burger and Chili cheese fries.  It's not "gourmet" its just good food.  We will be back, and while it does take a while- that's sort of the norm when something is being made to order.  If I wanted fast food- I'd go to Sonic.

Went there with family to experience the famous cheesesteaks and to our surprise the food was extremely bland with no flavor whatsoever. It tasted as if we were just eating bread. I don't understand the hype but wouldn't take the trip there again.

Am I missing something here? I've tried this place twice, both on the recommendation of my son. First, because of all the rave reviews I tried the wings...huge disappointment! The seasoning was terrible and worst of all the skin was barely cooked. It was like they threw them in an oven for two minutes and served it. 

The next time was today. I was really hungry and decided to go against my better judgement and give them a second chance, hoping the wings were a fluke. This time I got Pulled Pork with creamy coleslaw. OMG so gross that I couldn't eat it After the first bite. It was grey looking, sitting in grease and tasted like someone poured liquid smoke on it and called it a day!  Sooooo gross!!!  And to top it off I paid for coleslaw and got pickled onions and cucumbers. The only good thing and the only reason I'm giving them two stars is because the French fries ... although they didn't put in any salt or ketchup... were good and the people were super nice! 

You want the best wings around? Go to the food truck WHERE THE FOOD in Ewing.

Tried Grace's for the first time this past weekend. Nice open atmosphere and friendly staff. Food was priced fairly and the menu was pretty extensive.  Breakfast was good and we didn't wait long. Only downside was that I was charged 1.99 to replace the potatoes with sliced Roma tomatoes. That should have been an even swap. Overall I do recommend!

The wait  was  too long when I have ordered ahead of time coming in. Pizza was ok but when I got the wings aNd started to eat the wIngs and got got sick that night and the next day. I hate to leave this remarks but I got sick

I ordered on the app and 45 minutes later my food still wasn't ready for pickup. I was told the kitchen was extremely busy. Funny the restaurant looked to be less than half full.

The cheesecake bites were horrible and they forgot to include the sauce. The wings were worse. Small and dry and not much meat on them. Simply the worse wings I've ever had. I could only eat 6 out of 18 and threw the rest away. I won't be back.
What a friendly place ... close to work and very comfortable!  Welcome to the Neighborhood we will be back for sure!!

Updating my review. Yet again another fail for blaze.
Placed an online order for curbside. Said it would be ready at 7:07. I pulled into the curbside pickup spot at 7:07 and called , I was told they were just finishing it up and would bring it out to me. At 7:28 I went inside to find my pizza sitting getting cold on the rack and staff were oblivious. 
I love that you have vegan options but your follow through is absolutely horrible!!

I went with my daughter for lunch on a Wednesday a couple weeks ago.  I ordered her the kids burger and fries and apple sauce.  McDonald's is better for a kids burger and fries... probably better quality with equally poisonous ingredients... 
I ordered the "big" Caesar salad. It was $15 with the chicken option.  The dressing did not seem homemade.  The only thing big about the salad was the ridiculoulously big plate. I would estimate it consisted of a precooked pre seasoned processed chicken breast, already made dressing, croutons, and a handful (1/4) head of romaine lettuce.  For $15 I want a bucket of salad-- give me the whole head of lettuce, make ur own dressing, and use real chicken, not fake processed pre seasoned chicken... no thanks to this chain

Though I've driven by here many times, I had actually never been here until recently. 

After having beer with some friends next door, we came here for some late night snack. I wanted the frozen margarita, but they didn't have it. So I got a red sangria instead, which was great.

For food I got a chicken bowl, with a tortilla on the side. It came with tomatoes, lettuce, rice and beans. Everything was good except that there was barely any rice or beans (refer to the pic). The tortilla was fresh and warm, so together it was a decent meal.

Craving Pizza?

My first time trying this place and I honestly just wanted a good slice of pizza and Buffalo wings.

I scrolled the menu and the first thing that caught my attention were the King Cake Knots. 

It's carnival season and King Cakes are everywhere despite COVID-19 and a cancelled Mardi Gras for New Orleans and the surrounding areas; and who doesn't love (garlic) knots.

Let me tell you, if you're reading this and they are still on the menu, ORDER THEM!

These taste like heaven in a pastry! 
Cinnamon knots covered in a light King Cake Frosting nom nom!

The main course.
Pepperoni Stromboli.

Talk about a gourmet pizza roll, yum! The crust was a tad bit oily but still had great flavor. The tomato sauce was delicious and tangy and paired well with the fresh pepperoni.
It definitely hit the spot.

And last but not least were the Smoked Chicken Wings!

Hot wings are one of my love languages and these made me fall in love all over again. I wasn't familiar with this type of chili but was intrigued by other images of the wings on their website. 

The first bite I was met with a mouth full of spice. These wings were so full of flavor, tender and juicy! The house ranch pairs perfectly with this dish and even balances out the heat!

I placed an order online using the toasttab app and my order was ready in 20 minutes. Upon my arrival I called and asked if I could do a curbside pickup and the man that answered the phone simply asked for the type of vehicle I was in and brough
Very disappointing. One olive, one cucumber, and one tomato. 6 dollars....both salads looked like this

My favorite restaurant in St. Louis! The atmosphere, the food, and the service are beyond what you'd expect in STL. The decor here reminds me of upscale restaurants on the West Coast and the chefs here know their flavors. Super unique combinations that still taste amazing and feel healthy, clean, and refined.

During an awesome visit to Greenbench, we got super hungry and ordered from Red Mesa which is right next door. The food was ready quickly and my wife brought it back over to the brewery to eat there. Unfortunately, there are no pictures with this review - the food was so delicious that it was gone before we realized we hadn't taken any pictures. I highly recommend both The Pork Verde Burrito and The Pork Colorado Burritos. The flavors of the homemade sauces and the tender slow cooked pork are what really make these so good. The kids had a massive chicken quesadilla which they demolished. The Queso Blanco and Chips portions are huge too. Everything was top notch! Highly recommended!
Service was so bad I never got to order. And someone with restuarant announced there would be a 45 to an hour before the food would come out. I left after wasting 25 minutes waiting to order.

What a great company! I've ordered several times and all of the meals are great. I received an order today and I had a minor issue. I chatted with someone on their website, and the owner of the company called me within 5 minutes. He resolved my issue and I couldn't have been more satisfied with the customer service. This is exactly why I love supporting small businesses in my local community. Keep up the great work!!!!

I found a menu for this establishment  in the staff lounge at the school I work at. I pulled up for lunch was AMAZED at the grilled wings! I opted for the "Mixed BBQ" sauce which was perfect for folks who like sweet and spicy. They were so fire I had to smash in the parking lot! Lol

The food was excellent. Everything fried is gluten-free so it is Celiac friendly. I had the Gumbo (not gf) but also delicious. Wanted to try several of the specials they had. We will definitely be back.

I LOVE THIS PLACE...it is an absolute hidden beach pearl! My sister and I arrived this morning from a 10 -hour overnight drive from Nashville and were starving. Paradise Grille is the perfect little beach shack with fresh food, made swiftly, great customer service and tons of seating. I can't recommend this place enough...their ketchup packets don't have high fructose corn syrup and they use paper straws. #ecofriendly #yesplease #ParadiseGrille

#ProTip - Ms. Patty makes THE BEST dirty and spicy Bloody Marys!!

Always amazing! Always delicioussss! Great service & great food :) Attached are 2 different visits and as you can see, both were a success. I personally had the pasta the first visit & then lemon chicken (my NEW favorite) the second. The new lemon chicken dish literally is amazing. Everything goes so well together and isn't even heavy. I normally don't eat corn grits but I'm glad this night I did, GREAT job walks on !
Delicious Chow fun! Helped my cravings for decent Chinese food! Make the drive from Camarillo because it's worth it. Also the dumplings are so good and fresh! Highly recommend!
1st time here service was amazing. Our waitress recommended a few things and they were all so freaking good.  Pizza and pasta were both amazing. We look forward to coming back very soon

I was looking for a 30 min or less place to stop in for lunch. I chose Kneaders thinking it would be a sure thing to get a bowl of soup and slice of bread  in under 30 min.  I was wrong on my choice as it took 25 min standing in a line with 3 people in front of me.  As I stood there I started to notice that the staff was unorganized.  The person who worked the window would leave window to gather food for a table, and the register attendant would leave to attend to window.  The cook would only make sandwiches and never leave his area to help the inside line orders.  I believe at lunchtime they needed one person dedicated to soup, bread, and dessert area.   The soup was good when I finally received it but my slice of bread with my order turned out to be a whole loaf of bread.  My suggestion is to avoid eating in and go through drive through for lunch.   I will return when I crave soup again.

This was one of the worst dining experiences ever. The staff was rude and the food was subpar. The food quality was a step below an elementary school lunchroom. At least the lunch lady at school is nice to you, unlike the drill sergeant at Monell's. And, school lunchrooms don't charge $25.00 per person to to leave you feeling sick and confused about what just happened.
This place is a diamond in the rough for sure! Delicious food, nice people and prompt service.

I have been coming here since my college days, although back then I was mostly filling up on their incredible egg rolls and fried rice. The egg rolls are still delicious especially with the spicy mustard! I come back here every chance I get!

Walked in order two #4's which is two slices of pizza and drink. Price was right where it needs to be for this slice and the actually slice is top notch. Having been in NYC many times this is exactly what you would find and expect as slice of pizza from NYC. The size tells it all in its name and is worth everything. Did I mention that sauce??? I need a copy of that flavor, 5 stars hands down
